# scamp_floating_ip (Resource)

A floating IPv4 address. Reserved on its own and moved between VMs without re-creating anything, which is what makes zero-downtime failover possible. Attachment follows the same shape as scamp_volume: set attached_vm_id to attach, clear it to detach.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A floating address outlives the machine behind it, which is what makes
# failover possible: point it at another VM and the address keeps working.
resource "scamp_floating_ip" "web" {
  display_name   = "web-vip"
  attached_vm_id = scamp_vm.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `attached_vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM the address points at. Leave unset to reserve the address without attaching it.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the panel.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the address was reserved.
- `id` (String) UUID of the floating IP.
- `ip_address` (String) The reserved IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address that comes with the reservation, if the pool assigned one.
- `status` (String) reserved, attaching, floating or detaching.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_floating_ip.web 4dc62fd1-d05d-47a9-9c2b-2f4e61a2761a
```
